lines.zh: 肚皮贴着沙，我一拱一拱。
lines.en: Belly on sand, I haul myself forward.
My flippers push the ground like little hops.
I slide off the rock into cool water.

lines.zh: 晒够太阳了，挪到阴影里。
lines.en: Sunbathed enough; I shuffle into the shade.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子，往浪声那边走。
lines.en: I drag myself toward the sound of surf.

lines.zh: 沙粘在湿毛上，越走越沉。
lines.en: Sand sticks to wet fur, heavier each step.

lines.zh: 前面那块石头，正好靠着歇。
lines.en: That rock ahead is perfect to lean on.
I roll over to warm my back.

lines.zh: 潮水漫过来，我往高处挪。
lines.en: The tide creeps in; I move higher.

lines.zh: 水下我飞快，地上我慢吞吞。
lines.en: Swift in water, slow and clumsy on land.
The whole pod shifts, piled together.
I lift my head and sniff the wind.
My flippers slap the sand, pat-pat.

lines.zh: 绕过海藻堆，味道不太好。
lines.en: I go around the kelp pile; it smells.

lines.zh: 我扭着身子滑下礁石，肚皮发凉。
lines.en: I squirm down the rock, my belly going cold.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到水边，先伸鼻尖试试。
lines.en: I shuffle to the water and test it with my nose first.
The salt smell is getting closer—onward.
I roll over and let the sun reach my belly.

lines.zh: 冰面上趴着，太阳晒得正好。
lines.en: Flat on the ice, the sun is just right.
One roll on the ice and I'm cool.
Don't scare off the fish under the ice.
Belly on the ice, I slide far.
Don't stop me; fish are moving under the ice.
The ice cracked; I'll take the water route.
The ice is slick; I slide on my belly.
Ice chunks all the way; slow going.
I've crawled this ice a hundred times.

lines.zh: 别掉队，跟紧我拍水的尾。
lines.en: Do not fall behind; follow my splashing tail.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我就滑进水里。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I slide in.
Sliding on the ice is faster than walking.
The ice is slick; I slide all the way.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子，从冰面挪到水边。
lines.en: I haul my belly from the ice to the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我摊平在沙上，晒得发懒。
lines.en: I flatten on the sand, lazy in the sun.

lines.zh: 呼噜声从鼻子里漏出来。
lines.en: A snore leaks out of my nose.

lines.zh: 眼睛闭着，耳朵还听着浪。
lines.en: Eyes shut, my ears still track the waves.

lines.zh: 尾鳍轻轻拍水，一下一下。
lines.en: My tail flipper taps the water slowly.

lines.zh: 短毛晒干了，摸起来发亮。
lines.en: My short fur dries and shines.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打个哈欠，露出牙。
lines.en: I yawn and show a row of small teeth.

lines.zh: 有只苍蝇落在鼻尖，我懒得动。
lines.en: A fly lands on my nose; I do not move.

lines.zh: 冰山水冷，晒过的石头暖。
lines.en: Glacier water is cold; sunned stone is warm.
I roll over to sun the other side.

lines.zh: 远处的虎鲸声，我听见了。
lines.en: Far off, I hear the call of an orca.

lines.zh: 水面有鱼跳，我不想起身。
lines.en: Fish jump nearby; I cannot be bothered.
The rest of the pod is dozing too.
I grunt once and sink back into rest.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，影子爬到身上。
lines.en: The sun shifts and shade crawls over me.
Where did that school of fish go?
On the ice I spread out like a pancake.
These rocks are piled like a city.
Spread out on the ice, soaking sun.
Ice water presses on my belly.
Held it too long—time to surface.

lines.zh: 我在冰上滑，肚子贴地面。
lines.en: I slide on ice, belly to the ground.
How deep is it under this ice?
My bubbles rise and pop.
On the ice, only I am sunning.

lines.zh: 冰面上我翻个身，滑进水里。
lines.en: On the ice I roll over and slide in.
Sunlight makes the ice shine.

lines.zh: 冻洋的冰面，晒得肚子发烫。
lines.en: The frozen ocean ice warms my belly.

lines.zh: 我油亮的皮，被阳光照得发白。
lines.en: My sleek hide goes pale in the sun.

lines.zh: 你站我旁边很久了，有事？
lines.en: You have stood here long; something you need?

lines.zh: 手里那三条鱼，是给我的吗？
lines.en: Those three fish in your hand, for me?
Your boots are still wet with seawater.
I tilt my head at you, puzzled.
Do not reach to pet; my teeth are quick.

lines.zh: 你身上没有虎鲸的味道，还好。
lines.en: You do not smell of orca; that helps.
Crouch down and I will come closer.
The fish in your hand is dripping.
I blink slowly; do not read too much into it.
Once you have looked enough, toss a fish.
Nothing beats sunning on the ice.
Seal? I'll remember that.
You smell of a fish spear.
You walk, I lounge.
Dive under the ice, or wait?
On the ice, I was sunning nicely.
Standing still like that is creepy.
There's snow on your boots.
Your bubbles are bigger than mine.
The ice creaks when you step.
I snap awake and bolt for the water.

lines.zh: 这一下把整群都惊起来了。
lines.en: That blow startles the entire pod awake.

lines.zh: 皮上留了印子，火辣辣的。
lines.en: There is a mark on my hide, burning.
I roll off the rock into the surf.
Who hit me? I was not even awake.

lines.zh: 叫声变了调，同伴都回头。
lines.en: My call cracks; the pod all turns.
I tuck my flippers and back away.
A trail drags through the wet sand.
The wound is light, but I will not stay.
Only the water is safe; I am going.
You nicked my hind flipper.
No second hit—enough.
Hit before I could dive.
Blood spreads in the ice water.
The reef gap is too narrow, I am stuck.
This coat is fur, not scales.
Round as I am, my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 我的鳍拖着，实在游不动。
lines.en: My flippers drag; I truly can't swim.

lines.zh: 我在冰上打了个滚，滑进水里。
lines.en: I roll across the ice and slide into the water.

lines.zh: 谁在水里放钩子，冰面也扎。
lines.en: Who set hooks here? Even the ice stings.

lines.zh: 三条鱼，我可以凑得很近。
lines.en: Three fish, and I will come very close.

lines.zh: 腥味顺着海水飘过来了。
lines.en: The fishy smell drifts in with the tide.

lines.zh: 我撑起身子，往前挪了两步。
lines.en: I push myself up and shuffle two steps.

lines.zh: 这鱼新鲜，眼睛还是亮的。
lines.en: This fish is fresh; its eyes still shine.
Lower your hand, and I can reach.
After this one, are there two more?
I will not snatch; I wait for you to let go.
Face the fish toward me and I lean in.

lines.zh: 水里抓鱼太费劲，这样省事。
lines.en: Chasing fish is tiring; this is easier.
Wave it again and I will lunge.
Smells like a fresh catch.
I slide fast over the ice.
Could you spare me this fish?
Fine—I do want a bite.

lines.zh: 鱼的腥味，隔着冰都闻得到。
lines.en: Fish smell carries through the ice.
Is this shiny thing edible?
I followed that fishy smell a long way.
The fish is at your feet. I don't dare.
Fish under the ice. I'll wait.
Just one fish, no more.
You stepped on my flipper.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边挤过去，借个道。
lines.en: I squeeze past your leg for room.

lines.zh: 这堆沙子是我晒背的地方。
lines.en: This patch of sand is my sunning spot.
A bump is nothing; my hide is thick.
Step back; I am about to roll over.
You are blocking my path to the water.
You are standing in a pod member's spot.
I grunt once, as a warning.

lines.zh: 两具胖身子挤在一起，真挤。
lines.en: Two fat bodies squeeze together; so cramped.
Make way; I am going in to cool off.
My belly is slick. A bump will not hurt.
You knocked my round belly off balance.
That knocked my belly onto the ice.
That bump nearly flipped me.
Who rammed me? Forget it.
Don't shove me into the rocks.
All this blubber still hurts.
Ice is slick — I can't brake on it.
You knocked even my bubbles crooked.
Don't dash around under the ice!

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脖子蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I nuzzle against your neck.

lines.zh: 叫一声，让整片滩都听见。
lines.en: I call out for the whole beach to hear.

lines.zh: 我们并排趴着，尾巴搭一起。
lines.en: We lie side by side, tails touching.

lines.zh: 水里绕圈，是跳给你看的。
lines.en: I circle in the water, dancing for you.
This rock belongs to the two of us now.
Lean in; you are flattening my fur.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，还在这片滩。
lines.en: Same beach, same time, next year.
I slap the water; slap back at me.
The pup will squeeze between us.

lines.zh: 叫声低一点，别招来虎鲸。
lines.en: Keep the call low; do not summon orcas.
Two shadows side by side under the ice.
Your fur shines in the sun.
Do not tread on these eggs on the ice.
A shell, laid on your belly.
Let's share this ice floe.
The way you roll is lovely.

lines.zh: 这块冰面，我们俩轮着用。
lines.en: We two share this ice floe in turns.

lines.zh: 冰面上的叫声，你听见了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear my call over the ice?
The under-ice road—let's take it together.

lines.zh: 冰面上滑一段，也算走路。
lines.en: Sliding on the ice counts as walking.
I will carry this shell back.

lines.zh: 海床上的东西，我捡得到。
lines.en: Things on the seabed, I can fetch them.
This stone is slick; I nearly dropped it.

lines.zh: 鼻子拱一拱，沙里就有货。
lines.en: A nudge of my snout and the sand yields.
Kelp is tangled around my flipper.

lines.zh: 叼着东西，我只能慢慢挪。
lines.en: Carrying this, I can only shuffle slowly.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿值不值钱？我猜。
lines.en: Is this thing worth anything? I wonder.
Dredged from the bottom, and quite heavy.
A fish on the ground belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我把东西放你脚边，算交易。
lines.en: I set it by your feet; we have traded.

lines.zh: 三条鱼换一趟海床，成交。
lines.en: Three fish for a trip to the seabed. Deal.

lines.zh: 冰面上这块，我趴着刚好。
lines.en: This patch of ice fits me perfectly.
Found on the ice floe. Mine for now.
Carrying it, I swim lopsided.
I slide on ice faster than I walk.
Sunbathing on the ice is best.

lines.zh: 又一块，肚皮上放不下了。
lines.en: Another—no room on my belly.
This thing's hard on my teeth.
Slide across the ice — and I've got it.

lines.zh: 滑进冰洞，你就找不到我。
lines.en: Slide into an ice hole and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 那只鱼跑得慢，我跟上了。
lines.en: That fish is slow; I have caught up.

lines.zh: 水花一动，我就知道位置。
lines.en: A splash tells me exactly where it is.

lines.zh: 这家伙在我晒背的地方乱晃。
lines.en: This one keeps wandering through my sunning spot.
Anything near the water is easy to handle.

lines.zh: 我先潜下去，从下面顶它。
lines.en: I dive first and strike from below.

lines.zh: 它没发现我，尾巴还在摆。
lines.en: It has not noticed me; its tail still wags.
Once I bite, I will not let go.
In the water I am far faster than it.
Circle it; do not let it reach shore.

lines.zh: 它退到礁石后面了，绕过去。
lines.en: It backed behind the rock; I go around.

lines.zh: 冰面上那条鱼是我先看到的。
lines.en: I saw that fish on the ice first.
That fat one lasts me a day.
The ice hole opens once.
That shape under the ice—stop playing rock.
Belly low, slide into the water.
I drop through a hole in the ice.
I slide faster than you on ice.
Waited all day at the crack—now.
That one moved first—I bite first.
The ice cracks and I launch.

lines.zh: 我贴在水面，只露个鼻子。
lines.en: I hug the surface, only my nose showing.

lines.zh: 再近一点，它就逃不掉了。
lines.en: A little closer and it cannot escape.
Hold the tail still, or it will bolt.
It is heading for the shallows; perfect.
I swing downstream to block its path.

lines.zh: 冰下光线暗，它看不见我。
lines.en: Under the ice it is dark; it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 憋着这口气，还能再等等。
lines.en: I can hold this breath a while longer.
It has stopped to gnaw on kelp.
Cut in from the side, quickly.

lines.zh: 水底的影子越来越近了。
lines.en: The shadow on the seabed grows closer.
The ice hole is behind me—come closer.
I know this ice with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 别下水，水下是我的地盘。
lines.en: Don't go in. The water's mine.
Don't run for the ice—I'm faster there.
The ice ends—and I'm still here.
You can't catch me on the ice.
On the sand, all I can do is flap my flippers.
The water under the ice counts for me.
Your scent spreads under the ice.
The ice hole has just one way out.

lines.zh: 我一头撞过去，水花四溅。
lines.en: I ram it headfirst, spraying water everywhere.
My teeth clamp its fin; it cannot flee.
One shove and it flips over.
My flipper slaps down and the water shakes.
It tries to run; I block the way.

lines.zh: 咬一口就退，免得被反咬。
lines.en: Bite and retreat before it bites back.

lines.zh: 水里翻身，我用尾巴抽它。
lines.en: Rolling in the water, I whip it with my tail.

lines.zh: 它缩进石缝，我拱开石头。
lines.en: It hides in a crevice; I shove the stone.
A growl rolls up from my throat.
Fight done; I return to sun my back.
On the ice I shuffle, slowly.
Grr—catch this one.
For the ones on the ice—a bite.
One bite, and it is salty.
One bite, then you back off.
One sweep of my flipper hits too.
Stay away from my ice hole.
These canines aren't for show.
That ice hole is my front door.
Fast legs, but faster in water.
I surface through the surf and climb ashore.

lines.zh: 这片沙滩晒得暖，正合适。
lines.en: This beach is warm; just right.

lines.zh: 整群跟着浪一起上来了。
lines.en: The whole pod rides the waves ashore.
First, I find a flat rock and flop onto it.

lines.zh: 冰山水凉，我挑东边的滩。
lines.en: Glacier water is cold; I pick the east shore.
Salt fills my nose.
I shake my head and water flies off.
Landing presses a shallow pit in the sand.
There is a school of fish offshore; later.

lines.zh: 新地方，先看有没有虎鲸。
lines.en: New place; first check for orcas.
I just slid out of the ice hole.
The icy current shoves me out.
I poke my head out of the ice hole.

lines.zh: 沙滩的沙子钻进我的毛里。
lines.en: Beach sand works into my fur.
First, a floe to flop onto.
I fill up and dive.

lines.zh: 我趴在冰面上，先喘口气。
lines.en: Flat on the ice, I catch my breath.
Someone walking on the ice?
New ice, a new fishy smell.

lines.zh: 冰面上滑下来，谁在等我？
lines.en: Slid onto the ice — who's waiting?
My fur singed; a burnt smell rises.
The fire singed my flipper.

lines.zh: 从礁石掉下去，肚皮着地。
lines.en: I fell off the rock and landed on my belly.

lines.zh: 我从冰面滑下来，摔在沙上。
lines.en: I slid off the ice and hit the sand.

lines.zh: 一口气没憋住，水灌进来。
lines.en: I lost my breath and water rushed in.
I choked on water—that shouldn't happen.
The blast throws me a long way.
Who set off a blast underwater?

lines.zh: 有东西扎进背上的脂肪。
lines.en: Something pierced the blubber on my back.
I rolled and half-dodged it.
Light binds my flippers; I cannot move.

lines.zh: 我这层脂肪，挡得住冷，不挡魔法。
lines.en: This blubber stops the cold, not magic.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连海藻都啃。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I even chew kelp.
Where's the school? I'm starving.

lines.zh: 雷落在海面，我潜了下去。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea; I dive under.
The bolt left my fur tingling.
Nothing under me, not even water.
No ice, no water—nothing.
